info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Qlik Sense Service About Components API
Qlik Sense Enterprise Get installed components

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of all components installed in the Qlik Sense system, including their names, versions, and status information.
